identity.title: [v0.92][WP-04.07][defect] Harden lease mutation authority and bounded proof

values.task_boundary: Repair only the four merged WP-04.07 defects in the existing lease authority implementation and its issue-owned tests/proof.
deliverables: Hard-bounded atomic lineage and snapshot state
Distinct LeaseGrant and Activate state transitions
Fresh exact-head review and green ready corrective PR
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Future and stale caller indexes fail closed without replay-state mutation.
AC-2: Lineage-count and serialized-size capacity failures are deterministic and atomic.
AC-3: Executed Rust negative cases have exact denominator, name, result, and digest parity.
AC-4: LeaseGrant refuses existing authority and Activate requires prior authority.
AC-5: Focused nextest, strict Clippy, exact receipt validation, review, and CI pass.
non_goals: Unrelated lease redesign or sibling work
